state.seed_assertion: Continuity testing should only be performed on de-energized circuits to avoid false positive results from the supply voltage.

sentences.1: Continuity testing should only be performed on de-energized circuits to avoid false positive results from the supply voltage.
sentences.2: Continuity checks are useful for wiring verification but only with the circuit de-energised.
sentences.3: Trying to run a continuity test on a live 24 VDC circuit will give you a beep regardless of the fault because the meter's test current is swamped by the supply.
sentences.4: The 24 VDC supply should be monitored near the affected load, not only at the power supply terminals, to investigate power and grounding issues.
sentences.5: Monitor the 24 VDC supply near the affected load, not only at the power supply terminals.
sentences.6: Power problem investigation should examine loading, inrush, loose terminals, protective-device behavior and shared commons.
sentences.7: Check loading, inrush, loose terminals, protective-device behavior and shared commons.
sentences.8: When measuring across a device and the LED is ON but the meter reads 0 VDC at the terminal, the issue may be the output common, fuse, or field power.
